## Reporting notes

- Report missing post-tests separately by group.
- Record exclusions only when they follow the prespecified eligibility/data-quality rules.
- Do not remove participants merely because their gain is negative, their score is low, or their questionnaire response is unfavorable.
- If intact classes are used, describe assignment as class-level/quasi-experimental rather than implying individual randomization.
